technique: Place feet mid-platform; unlock knees slightly; lower until thighs approach torso without rounding lumbar spine.
Press through mid-foot to near lockout without slamming the sled.
setup: Adjust seat so hips and knees stay comfortable; safety stops set.
safety: Do not allow the lower back to peel off the pad.
contraindications: Uncontrolled hypertension for heavy isometric straining
